We need to implement reduction from Vertex Cover to Clique. Known reduction: Given graph G=(V,E) and integer k, construct complement graph G' where vertices same, edges are non-edges of G (i.e., for each pair u<v not in E, add edge). Then a vertex cover of size k in G exists iff there is a clique of size n - k in complement graph. So reduce instance (n, edges, k) to (n, edges_complement, n - k). Need to handle edge cases per definitions. Also ensure that reduction works for all k, including negative, >n, etc. Let's examine edge cases: For Vertex Cover, yes if k<0 always no. For Clique, yes if k <=0 always yes. Our reduction should preserve answer.

If k<0: Vertex Cover answer no. Our reduction would give target k' = n - k which > n (since -k positive). For Clique, answer is no if k' > n. Since k' = n - k > n because -k >0, so k'>n, answer no. Good.

If k >= n: Vertex Cover always yes. Then k' = n - k <=0. Clique yes because k' <=0 always yes. Good.

If graph has no edges: Vertex Cover yes for any k>=0. Complement graph is complete graph (all possible edges). Clique of size n - k exists? For any k >=0, need clique size n - k. Since graph is complete, any subset is clique, so yes if n - k <= n (always) and >=0? Clique yes condition is at least k' vertices. If k' <= n, which holds. If k'>n then no, but that would be when k<0 which we handled. So works.

Edge case: k=0 Vertex Cover yes only if no edges. Complement graph clique size n. If original has edges, answer no. Our reduction: k'=n. Clique of size n exists only if graph complement is complete => original has no edges. So matches.

Thus reduction correct.

class VertexCover:

class Clique:
    """Clique.

    edge between every two of them.
